content.value_statement: Azure teams need clear examples for deploying Weights & Biases through Azure Resource Manager. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through .NET SDK workflows.
actual_capabilities: Explains package installation for Azure.ResourceManager.WeightsAndBiases and Azure.Identity.
Shows how to create a W&B instance with marketplace, user, region, and managed identity settings.
Demonstrates reading, listing, updating, and deleting W&B instance resources.
Documents SAML SSO configuration through Entra ID fields.
Maps key SDK types, regions, offer details, and reference links.
Shows a basic W&B Python SDK connection after Azure deployment.
limitations: It is documentation only; it does not execute Azure operations by itself.
It targets preview SDK and API versions that may change.
It uses placeholders and example domains that users must replace.
It does not verify pricing, quotas, or tenant-specific marketplace availability.

use_cases.title: Provision W&B Instance
use_cases.description: Plan a .NET workflow for creating an Azure Marketplace deployed Weights & Biases instance.

use_cases.title: Configure Enterprise SSO
use_cases.description: Map required Entra ID values before enabling SAML single sign-on for a W&B resource.

use_cases.title: Maintain Cloud Resources
use_cases.description: Review examples for listing, tagging, updating, and deleting W&B resources through Azure Resource Manager.

prompt_templates.title: Create My First Instance
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to outline the .NET steps for creating a W&B instance in an existing Azure resource group. Include placeholders and authentication setup.

prompt_templates.title: List Current Deployments
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to explain how to list W&B instances by resource group and subscription. Include the key data fields to inspect.

prompt_templates.title: Configure SAML SSO
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to prepare a SAML SSO update plan for an existing W&B instance. Include Entra ID values and validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Review Production Rollout
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review a production rollout plan for Azure W&B. Cover region choice, managed identity, tags, provisioning checks, and deletion safeguards.

output_examples.input: Create a W&B instance for a new ML platform team.
output: A step-by-step plan covering packages, authentication, resource group lookup, marketplace details, admin user fields, region, managed identity, and provisioning checks.
A reminder to replace placeholders and confirm marketplace terms before deployment.

output_examples.input: Add SAML SSO to an existing instance.
output_examples.output: The response identifies the instance, lists required Entra ID values, explains SSO state settings, and notes that the update uses existing resource data.

output_examples.input: Audit available operations before production use.
output: A capability map for create, read, list, update, delete, and name availability workflows.
Operational cautions for preview SDK changes, cost checks, and production deletion controls.

best_practices: Replace every placeholder with tenant-specific values before running any sample.
Use managed identity and Entra ID SSO for production deployments.
Confirm cost, region, and marketplace plan details in Azure before provisioning.
anti_patterns: Do not run deletion examples against production resources without a recovery plan.
Do not publish real admin email addresses or subscription identifiers in prompts.
Do not assume preview SDK types remain stable across package upgrades.

faq.question: Does this skill run Azure commands?
faq.answer: No. It provides documentation and examples for users or agents to adapt deliberately.

faq.question: Which SDK package does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers Azure.ResourceManager.WeightsAndBiases with Azure.Identity for authentication.

faq.question: Can it help with SSO?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents SAML SSO fields for Entra ID integration.

faq.question: Is it only for .NET?
faq.answer: The main workflows use .NET. It also shows a basic W&B Python SDK connection after deployment.

faq.question: Does it include pricing guidance?
faq.answer: No. Users must verify Azure Marketplace pricing, terms, and quotas separately.

faq.question: What should I verify before deployment?
faq.answer: Verify subscription access, marketplace plan availability, region support, SSO values, and production deletion controls.
